messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (gateway) — impact: ~8% of requests failing since 04:02 UTC. On-call: Alex. Correlation: cor-id root sample = 0f4a9c2b
Alex: I'm seeing a big cluster of 502/504 from the edge -> gateway layer. Errors correlate with high upstream latencies (200-800ms) and lots of gateway retries.
Priya: grabbing ingress proxy logs + KV logs. ETA 2m. Any customer visible errors yet?
Linda: Product report: a few paying customers reported timeouts in the last 5 mins, some 30s client timeouts. No feature-level degradation flagged yet.
Jamal: on runtime. Hypothesis: model host timeouts causing gateway retries and amplification. Could be an autoscale gap on the dedicated pool.
Sasha: infra, I see a surge of retransmits from the gateway to model-pool-2, retransmit count +150% since 04:01. Also many queued requests in the router.
Mika: adding correlation id pattern to logs: we should search for "0f4a9c2b" across traces.
Alex: creating timeline in-thread. Starting timeline now.
Alex: TIMELINE (quick):
```
04:00:55 UTC - small latency uptick begins
04:01:20 UTC - gateway retries spike (x3)
04:02:10 UTC - 502/504 rate rises to ~8%
04:03:00 UTC - first customer reports
04:05:00 UTC - oncall paged
04:08:00 UTC - mitigation step: increase pool size suggested
```
Priya: logs: ingress link https://logs.internal/redwood/ingress?q=0f4a9c2b (sample saved)
Priya: pasted sample gateway log: 
```
{"ts":"2412345680","correlation_id":"0f4a9c2b","path":"/v1/generate","status":502,"upstream":"model-pool-2","upstream_latency_ms":612,"gateway_retries":2}
```
Sasha: infra-bot reports node cpu on model-pool-2 at 72% but queue depth on grpc workers increased to 480 (norm ~60). Looks like worker saturation not CPU.
Jamal: here's runtime stack trace snippet from model container: 
```
[2024-05-12T04:02:09Z] WARN kvcache: miss. inflight=312 queue_len=420
[2024-05-12T04:02:10Z] ERROR timeout: request exceeded 15s processing limit
```
Alex: two immediate mitigation ideas: 1) temporarily disable gateway-level retries for this route to avoid amplification; 2) add surge capacity to model-pool-2 (scale to +4 nodes). Which to try first?
Priya: do #1 first. Retry amplification is likely making tail latency worse. I'll push a safe retry-disable via the gateway feature-flag (non-disruptive).
Sasha: prepping scale up on model-pool-2, but autoscaler is capped by reserved capacity. Can we borrow from pool-3?
Mika: I can shift a couple of spare nodes from pool-3 -> pool-2 for 10m window. Doing it now.
infra-bot: Scaling action started: migrating 2 nodes from pool-3 -> pool-2 (action id act-241234_01)
Alex: Priya — patch for retry-disable command (gateway): 
```
POST /admin/route-config
{"route":"/v1/generate","retries":0}
```
Priya: pushed. gateway config returns 200. Monitoring impact.
Jamal: after retry-disable, gateway retries dropped to ~5% of previous inside 20s. Error rate shifting: 502-> 504 timeouts dropped by half.
Linda: customer impact update: reports still trickling in but rate is lower. Notifying CS to prepare messaging if it stays.
Sasha: infra-bot: pool-2 nodes migrated; worker queue depth dropping from 420 -> 120 in ~40s. CPU stable.
Alex: good. Next: we need root cause hypotheses and evidence to collect. I'll list hypotheses and what logs/traces we need.
Alex: H1: model-pool worker starvation (KV cache misses -> inflight storm). Evidence: high inflight counts, KV miss rate, cache eviction logs. Logs: kvcache metrics, model container logs.
Alex: H2: config change earlier today increased dial timeouts causing retries (recent deploy at 03:50). Evidence: diff of gateway deploy, rollout logs, deploy trace id dpl-2412339000.
Alex: H3: client-side retry amplification (retry loop clients with low jitter). Evidence: client headers and source IP patterns -> many repeated requests.
Priya: collecting deploy timeline + config diffs. Found a gateway config tweak at 03:50 that increased upstream timeout from 10s -> 15s. Not obviously harmful but correlated. Pasting commit id: cbd3a7b.
Mika: cross-checking access logs for repeated identical correlation ids per source IP. If clients are retrying quickly we should see identical request IDs and short intervals.
Priya: saved trace bundle to /kvlogs/bundles/2412345678-bundle.tar.gz and uploaded to share: https://files.internal/redwood/incidents/2412345678/bundle.tar.gz
Jamal: runtime metrics: kvcache hitrate dropped from 84% -> 61% at spike. That aligns with H1. Also observed more frequent GC pauses on a subset of hosts.
Sasha: infra: node-level disk i/o saturated on 2 hosts in pool-2 around 04:01 (likely KV store thrash). pulling full dmesg/logs now.
Alex: action items: 
- (Priya) Attach deploy diff + commit to thread (in progress)
- (Jamal) Collect model container GC + kvcache eviction traces for hosts with high inflight
- (Sasha/Mika) Confirm migrated nodes stabilized and prepare roll-back plan if needed
- (Linda) CS/Pager: prepare customer note and severity update (P2->P1 if new reports increase)

Linda: I'll hold P1 escalation checkbox off for now; waiting 30m post-mitigation to reassess.
Alex: good. We'll keep monitoring. If error rate doesn't go down to <1% in 10m, we escalate to live conference call.
Priya: added debug flags to gateway to emit sampling of upstream raw traces for postmortem.
Mika: marking in ticket: INC-2412345678. Also saving this thread into ticket comments.
incident-bot: Watchdog: recording timeline snapshot and thread link for RCA: https://incidents.internal/INC-2412345678
Alex: thanks everyone. I'll update again in 8m with error-rate snapshot.
